description: The same shape as `full` with exactly four problems: a TBD marker in spec.md (error), two parallel tasks sharing a target file, one brief over 8,000 characters, one test-only task (warnings).

tasks.title: Session store and types
acceptance: Given a store and `now = 0`, When `create("u1", 0)` is called with `sessionMinutes: 30`, Then the session has a 32-character hex id and `expiresAt` of 1,800,000.
Given a session that expires at 1,800,000, When `get(id, 1_800_000)` is called, Then it returns `null`.
Given a session that expires at 1,800,000, When `get(id, 1_799_999)` is called, Then the session is returned unchanged.

tasks.title: Login and logout endpoints
acceptance: Given a registered user, When `POST /api/login` is called with the right password, Then the response is 204 and sets an `HttpOnly` `sid` cookie.
Given a wrong password or an unknown user, When `POST /api/login` is called, Then the response is 401 with body `{ "error": "invalid credentials" }`.
Given a signed-in user, When `POST /api/logout` is called, Then the response is 204 and the session is removed from the store.

tasks.title: Session refresh near expiry
acceptance: Given `sessionMinutes: 30`, `refreshWindowMinutes: 5` and a session expiring at 1,800,000, When `touch(id, 1_500_001)` is called, Then `expiresAt` becomes 3,300,001.
Given the same session, When `touch(id, 1_500_000)` is called, Then `expiresAt` stays 1,800,000.
Given the same session, When `touch(id, 1_800_000)` is called, Then the result is `null`.

tasks.title: Auth middleware for protected routes
acceptance: Given no cookie, When `GET /api/me` is requested, Then the response is 401 `{ "error": "not signed in" }`.
Given a cookie whose signature does not verify, When any protected route is requested, Then the response is 401 and the store is not consulted.
Given a valid session, When `GET /api/me` is requested, Then the response is 200 and `req.session` was set for the handler.
Given a valid session inside the refresh window, When any protected route is requested, Then `refreshIfDue` was called once with the session id.
Given `/login`, `/api/login`, `/healthz` and `/static/app.css`, When requested without a cookie, Then none of them is answered 401 by the middleware.

tasks.title: Add session tests
acceptance: Given a running app and a registered user, When the test signs in and calls `/api/me` inside the refresh window, Then `expiresAt` moved forward.
Given the same run, When the test calls `/api/logout` and then `/api/me`, Then the second call is 401.
